note: Pre-registered before the first benchmark run, per PRD publication rule 1. The commit that adds this file is the hash quoted in every published post. Changing a scenario after the first run needs a note in the PR saying who changed it and why.
forkSlotNote: Null until T-B03 pins the mainnet fork slot. Every token.mint is null here on purpose: a mint chosen before the fork slot exists would be invented data, and the benchmark cannot contain any. T-B03 binds each selector to a real mint at the pinned slot.

profile.note: The reference trader profile these scenarios are written against. "Inside the profile", "4x usual size" and "past usual stop" are all relative to this block, so it is part of the pre-registration and changing it changes the benchmark.
